Preacher payouts

Who brought in buyers, and what you owe each Preacher. They earn 20–30% (by fighters held) of every coin pack and ORE-miner tip verified on-chain, owed in the token the buyer paid. Referred Degen Dojo NFT sales now earn too: 20–30% of the preacher half (6.5%) of the 13% royalty, owed in the token the royalty arrived in — each sale is checked on-chain (DD collection, royalty actually received, buyer ≠ preacher; other collections earn nothing). After you pay someone, press Mark paid and paste the payment's transaction signature. The key stays in this tab only.
